basic_info.description: 1463 Noe Street is a Mediterranean Revival residence spanning three levels with sweeping views of the downtown skyline and the bay. The main floor offers a living room with built-ins, coved ceilings, and a decorative fireplace, a formal dining room, and an east-facing kitchen where morning light fills the space, and the city stretches out below.    The middle level features a spacious family room and a private office opening directly onto a wide view deck, creating a seamless extension of the living space. On the garden level, two additional bedrooms open to the lower deck and a lush backyard, where the outdoor spaces become a rare escape in the heart of the city. Decks step down to a patio and yard edged with mature palms and layered plantings that evoke a tropical retreat, complete with a hot tub and generous space for entertaining or quiet afternoons.    Recent improvements include fresh interior and exterior paint, refinished floors, updated fixtures, and new kitchen countertops, giving the home a polished, move-in-ready finish. Garage parking, laundry, and generous storage complete the property, which sits on a quiet block between 27th and 28th Streets just minutes from Noe Valley's 24th Street corridor and Church Street cafs and restaurants.
